fact: SMART Zambia Institute, with the ITU and the Ministry of Youth, Sport and Arts, runs the Digital Transformation Centres Initiative to equip young people and women with digital skills, and has handed ICT equipment to the Mpika Youth Resource Centre with more handovers planned.
SMART Zambia Institute with the ITU handed ICT equipment to the Mukwela Youth Resource Centre in Kalomo to become a Digital Transformation Centre for digital-skills training of young people.

fact: The Smart Zambia Institute's procurement notice for the World Bank-financed Digital Zambia Acceleration Project includes a component on enhancing basic digital literacy, targeting underserved citizens.

Zambia's Government Chief Technology Officer launched the Girls in ICT Learn-A-Thon 2025, a three-week course with Cisco Networking Academy in cybersecurity, AI and data science, designed to reach girls in all provinces.

The SMART Zambia Institute's digital literacy programme for citizens, funded by ITU and Norway, trained 243 people (56 per cent women) across six localities (Mongu, Mumbwa, Chipata, Chibombo, Kafue, Choma) from 15 July to 26 September 2024, per ITU Academy.
